trap.label: bring ≠ take
trap.wrong: Bring this book to your sister when you go there.
trap.right: Take this book to your sister when you go there.
trap.why: Em português "levar" e "trazer" têm direção; o aluno usa bring sempre. Bring = em direção a quem fala; take = para longe.

fix.wrong: She brought her kids up in Rome, bringed them up well.
fix.right: She brought her kids up in Rome.

rewrite.prompt: Passe ao passado: “She brings a gift.”
Reescreva com bring up: “They raised three children.”
Reescreva com pronome: “Bring back the book.” → it
